description: This is a shell script that automates the process of setting up, building, patching, testing, and generating coverage reports for a complex C++ based embedded project involving multiple repositories such as Thunder, ThunderTools, entservices-apis, googletest, and entservices-appgateway. It manages dependencies, clones repositories, applies patches, configures and builds components with CMake, installs plugins, runs unit tests, and generates code coverage reports. It also handles plugin installation and verification, demonstrating its role as a comprehensive build and test automation script for the entservices-appgateway project.
